steps.title: Distribute Pre‑ligation mix
steps.instruction: Add 2 µL of Pre‑ligation mix to each column of the 96‑well plate that contains samples processed in Part 1.

steps.title: Input protocol parameters
steps.instruction: Enter the required parameters (e.g., sample IDs, volumes) into the OT‑2 Run App.

steps.title: Download protocol
steps.instruction: Download the generated protocol file from the OT‑2 Run App to your computer.

steps.title: Upload protocol to OT App
steps.instruction: Upload the downloaded protocol file back into the OT‑2 Run App.

steps.title: Set up deck
steps.instruction: Arrange the labware on the robot deck according to the provided deck map.

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipette
steps.instruction: Calibrate the labware, tip rack, and pipette using the OT‑2 App, following the on‑screen instructions or support articles.

steps.title: Run the protocol
steps.instruction: Press “Run” in the OT‑2 App to start the pre‑ligation procedure.
